scenes.title: Aperion PST vs RST super tweeter
scenes.say: Aperion PST or RST? Two super tweeters that add air and detail to your speakers. Here's the difference.

scenes.title: Sits on top of your speakers
scenes.say: Both sit on top of your existing speakers, connect without an extra amplifier, and share the same crossover and treble controls.

scenes.title: Planar ribbon, compact
scenes.say: The PST is three ninety nine a pair. It uses a planar magnetic ribbon, weighs just one point seven pounds each, and suits bookshelf speakers.

scenes.title: True aluminum ribbon
scenes.say: The RST is six forty nine a pair. It's a true three inch aluminum ribbon, twenty microns thin, with ninety six dB sensitivity, a better match for towers and more efficient speakers.

scenes.title:
Bookshelf → PST
Towers → RST
scenes.say: Bookshelf speakers and a tighter budget? Get the PST. Towers or high sensitivity speakers? Get the RST. Full comparison on WiseChoice K R dot com.
